definitions.explanation: A written message sent to someone, typically by mail.

examples.japanese: {手紙|てがみ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}きました→書く：00477_kaku⟧。
⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{手紙|てがみ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{来|き}ました→来る：00254_kuru⟧。
examples.english: A letter came from my friend.

examples.japanese: {手紙|てがみ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{送|おく}って→送る：00742_okuru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
⟦{祖母|そぼ}→祖母：00813_sobo⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{手紙|てがみ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{届|とど}いて→届く：00899_todoku⟧、⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧⟦{嬉|うれ}しかった→嬉しい：00822_ureshii⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: I was very happy when a letter arrived from my grandmother.

examples.japanese: ⟦{最近|さいきん}→最近：00881_saikin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦メール→メール：04435_meeru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{大切|たいせつ}な→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧⟦{時|とき}→時：02918_toki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{手紙|てがみ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}きます→書く：00477_kaku⟧。
examples.english: These days email is more common, but I write letters on important occasions.

notes:
{手紙|てがみ} literally means "hand paper" and refers specifically to physical letters, not electronic messages.

USAGE:
In modern Japan, ⟦メール→メール：04435_meeru⟧ (email) has largely replaced {手紙|てがみ} for everyday correspondence. However, {手紙|てがみ} remains important for formal occasions, thank-you notes, and personal sentiments.
